title: SEA//SIDE
description: An off-shore music series taking the experience aboard yachts, cruises, and sailboats.

landing.empty: New sailings drop seasonally. Charter a private SEA//SIDE for your group in the meantime.

pillars.title: Yacht sessions
pillars.line: Three-hour sailings with DJs and live acts on deck, from Long Beach and Marina del Rey to the SF Bay.

pillars.title: Sunset sets
pillars.line: Every lineup is built around golden hour, so the best set of the night lands as the sun goes down.

pillars.title: Private charters
pillars.line: Take the full SEA//SIDE production private for birthdays, teams and brand activations.

concepts.heading: Offshore Venue
concepts.body: Every set happens on the water — yachts, cruises, and sailboats sailing the Bay and the LA coastline.

concepts.heading: Music First
concepts.body: House and live electronic sets from the LUPFR roster and guest artists, from golden hour to sundown.

concepts.heading: The Community
concepts.body: An all-white dress code, a boat full of regulars, and the city skyline framing every drop.

title: HIGH//RISE
description: Corporate galas, product launches, and executive gatherings that produce music with class.

landing.statement: Company events people actually want to attend.
landing.empty: HIGH//RISE events are private. Tell us about yours.

pillars.title: Galas & launches
pillars.line: Product launches, award nights and galas with live music at the center.

pillars.title: Executive gatherings
pillars.line: Offsites, client dinners and leadership events with a curated soundtrack.

pillars.title: Full production
pillars.line: Venue, talent, sound, lighting and run-of-show handled by one team.

title: SOUND//CHECK
description: The LUPFR podcast — conversations with the artists, producers, and managers shaping the music industry.

landing.tagline: A music industry podcast by LUPFR.
landing.statement: Conversations from the other side of the stage.
landing.empty: New episodes arrive weekly from Fall 2026.

pillars.title: Artist conversations
pillars.line: Long-form talks with the artists who play LUPFR stages.

pillars.title: Industry voices
pillars.line: Managers, promoters and founders on how live music really works.

pillars.title: Live sessions
pillars.line: Stripped-back performances recorded alongside each episode.

title: IN//SIDE
description: Indoor live music experiences redefining what nights out mean in California.

landing.empty: The next IN//SIDE night is in the works. Get in touch to host one at your venue.

pillars.title: Venue takeovers
pillars.line: Warehouses, lounges and landmark rooms transformed for one night of live music.

pillars.title: Curated lineups
pillars.line: House, garage and live bands booked to match the room, from opener to close.

pillars.title: Immersive production
pillars.line: Lighting, sound, performers and theme, built so the night feels like somewhere else.

concepts.heading: The Room
concepts.body: Warehouses, marinas, and unexpected indoor spaces transformed into one-night venues.

concepts.heading: Late Sets
concepts.body: Programming built for the long haul — doors early, music running well past midnight.

concepts.heading: Underground
concepts.body: Boiler-room framing, close quarters, and a lineup pulled from the LUPFR network.

title: OUT//SIDE
description: The open-air music series melding nature and sound into one.

landing.empty: New OUT//SIDE sessions are announced on Instagram first.

pillars.title: Coast & park sessions
pillars.line: Live sets staged at the coastline, in the park and on the overlook, from Lands End to Venice Beach.

pillars.title: Pop-ups
pillars.line: Small-footprint shows that appear for an afternoon and leave no trace.

pillars.title: Day to dusk
pillars.line: Daytime programming that builds into golden hour, with sound tuned for the outdoors.

concepts.heading: Open Air
concepts.body: Rooftops, gardens, and outdoor spaces — no ceilings, no walls, just the horizon.

concepts.heading: Golden Hour
concepts.body: Sets timed to sundown, when the light and the music peak together.

concepts.heading: Nature + Sound
concepts.body: Locations chosen so the setting carries as much of the night as the lineup.

title: SKI//SIDE
description: Après ski concerts and slopeside sessions at mountain resorts.

landing.empty: SKI//SIDE launches in 2027. Follow along for dates and lineups.

pillars.title: World-class performers
pillars.line: Headline DJ sets as the lifts close, and full live bands on a mountain stage. When the lifts close, the party starts.

pillars.title: The scene
pillars.line: A branded gateway arrival, photo installations, fire-pit lounges and VIP decks, built at the base of the mountain.

pillars.title: The collection
pillars.line: Two merch lines: Heritage Alpine, with knits, pullovers and puffers, and Winter Athletic, with sculpt sets, flares and insulated layers.
